description.zh-CN: 受限档命令执行：内存/进程数/CPU 限额 + 无特权受限令牌 + 剪贴板隔离，一律审批；文件系统与网络不隔离（如实声明，策略面与 shell 同源）
description.en-US: Resource-limited command execution: memory/process/CPU caps + unprivileged restricted token + clipboard isolation, always approved; filesystem and network are NOT isolated (stated honestly, same command policy as shell)

tools.name: sandbox_run
tools.description: Run ONE whitelisted command inside a resource-limited sandbox: memory cap (mem_mb), active-process cap (max_procs), optional CPU hard cap (cpu_rate), clipboard isolation, whole-tree kill on timeout, and a restricted token (no privileges, cannot elevate). IMPORTANT: filesystem and network are NOT isolated — the command reads/writes and reaches the network with the same access as the host. Same command policy as `shell`: interpreters/wrappers/network commands are permanently locked; high-risk commands (rm, sudo, ...) are refused here (use `shell` with the unlock switch instead — the sandbox adds no filesystem isolation). Whitelist: ls, cat, grep, git status; more via host config. No pipes, no command substitution. Requires user approval.

command.description: single simple command, e.g. "git status"; no pipes/semicolons/backticks

cwd.description: optional working directory (absolute path, must exist)

timeout_secs.description: default 20 (env LOCOWRK_SANDBOX_TIMEOUT), max 120; whole process tree is killed on expiry

max_bytes.description: cap stdout/stderr each (default 65536, env LOCOWRK_SANDBOX_MAX_BYTES, max 262144)

mem_mb.description: per-process memory cap in MB (default 512, env LOCOWRK_SANDBOX_MEM_MB, max 4096); exceeding it fails allocations

max_procs.description: active process cap in the job (default 64, env LOCOWRK_SANDBOX_MAX_PROCS, max 256)

cpu_rate.description: optional hard CPU cap percent 10-99 (default off, env LOCOWRK_SANDBOX_CPU_RATE)
